title: The GKZ hypergeometric $\mathcal D$-module
summary: For an $(n\times N)$-matrix $A$ of rank $n$ with integer entries, Gelfand, Kapranov and Zelevinsky introduce a system of differential equations, called the $A$-hypergeometric system. We define the stable GKZ hypergeometric $\mathcal D$-module using cohomological functors, which is closely related to the $A$-hypergeometric $\mathcal D$-module and the $\mathcal D$-module underlying the better behaved GKZ system introduced by Borisov and Horja.
